findings_and_questions.first_contract: Operable window leaf compilation emits non-primary Iron parts and, for leaded glass with cames, LeadAlloy parts. The production window observer spawns each non-primary batch as a child of the SceneWindow. Review Observation::check tests GPU assets for root windows, but its child-parts loop checks only parts with sign ancestry or a boundary parent. Those window child mesh/image IDs are not checked by that loop; capture_views is gated by the resulting building_review::ready. A distinct child asset could therefore still be pending when this check returns ready.
findings_and_questions.condition: The child must exist or be expected and its distinct required asset must still be unprepared while all separately checked requirements pass. Other capture settling/readbacks and native renderer scheduling may incidentally make it ready; no incomplete screenshot or runtime occurrence was observed.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Identify every production batch required for a review view and include its actual mesh/material/image readiness and missing-child representation in the owning capture gate, while preserving legitimate optional parts and native IDs.
relationships: 059 Q-L12-f238115d43d2e895f929 and Q-L12-c0b87495151f633b7051 keep window observer, native asset and review readiness connections open. READ-L11-247 accurately described checks for root windows and sign/boundary parts, not an exhaustive child readiness guarantee.

Prior /root/mhr_character p16-window-leaf-spec packet first connected leaf batching and observer, but did not establish this new readiness comparison; its author, prior scopes and grep qualification remain separate. Central owns unique count and alias decision.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: observe sets pending_since only at the first non-ready observation and clears it during Configure; an intervening ready observation does not reset the timestamp. If readiness later drops again within the same non-Configure view, the 120-second comparison uses the original pending timestamp, not the start of the later pending period. The registered capture source returns to Configure between view completions.
findings_and_questions.condition: A ready-to-pending fluctuation must occur within one view after enough elapsed time; normal GPU residency stability, capture timing and scheduling were not established. The code does impose a bounded wait; this is not an indefinite wait claim.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Decide whether the timeout represents total per-view elapsed waiting or one continuous pending episode, and encode that policy with typed stage/context; preserve explicit Configure reset and terminal diagnostics.
relationships: 059 Q-L11-ae1080e6522145b1f863 preserves readiness/GPU/garden terminal versus pending questions; no claim that earlier record resolved this timing policy.

In Observation::check the same material was checked earlier before the lookup, so the source alone does not prove that material expect can fail. Serialization, I/O, lock poisoning and terminal error handling remain distinct boundaries.
findings_and_questions.condition: The rule mismatch is textual. No JSON, file, lock, GPU, or product operation was executed, and no claim of an observed failure or forced panic is made.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Preserve the viewer’s intended success/failure protocol while replacing prohibited operations with typed propagation or explicit handling if central owner reconciliation accepts the issue.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: select_pose indexes state.views[state.view] and then fixture.views[camera] without local bounds checks; frame selects the first qualifying opening for each target and reports an absence if none. State/camera validity, exit scheduling and source selection semantics are not wholly established by this body.
findings_and_questions.condition: A bad state/view or camera index must reach the system, or an intended target must be absent. Nearby capture code has a separate guard and view-length assertion, but full system scheduling/fixture validation were not inspected. No actual panic, stale view or missing target is asserted.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Trace capture/view producers, schedule and fixture admissibility before deciding a typed index or contextual error boundary; preserve intentional selection and optional profiles.
